faq.q: What is the origin of Abdulmateen?
faq.a: Abdulmateen is associated with Arabic. Abdulmateen is Arabic عَبْدُ الْمَتِين (ʿAbd al-Matīn), meaning 'servant of the Firm'.
Yes — the underlying form عَبْدُ الْمَتِين is Arabic.
Abdulmateen can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
